questions.question: Describe cost-based and demand-based pricing approaches?
questions.solution_html:
• Describe cost-based and demand-based pricing approaches. /
  • • Cost-based pricing: Price is determined by adding a fixed profit margin to the total
  • cost of production. Example: Cost-plus pricing.
  • • Demand-based pricing: Price is set based on consumer demand, willingness to pay,
  • and perceived value of the product. Higher demand leads to higher pricing.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: and perceived value of the product. Higher demand leads to higher pricing.

questions.question: What is the significance of the credit guarantee trust for micro and small enterprises?
questions.solution_html:
• What is the significance of the Credit Guarantee Trust for Micro and Small
  • Enterprises? /
  • The Credit Guarantee Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE) provides collateral-
  • free loans to MSMEs. Its significance includes:
  • • Reduces risk for lenders
  • • Encourages banks to finance small businesses
  • • Promotes entrepreneurship and MSME growth
  • • Supports first-time entrepreneurs without assets

questions.question: Explain the different types of entrepreneurs with examples.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the different types of entrepreneurs with examples. /
  • • Innovative entrepreneur: Introduces new products or ideas (e.g., tech startup
  • founders).
  • • Imitative entrepreneur: Adopts existing ideas in a new way.
  • • Fabian entrepreneur: Cautious and resistant to change.
  • • Drone entrepreneur: Refuses to adopt changes even at losses.
  • • Social entrepreneur: Works for social welfare (e.g., NGOs).
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: • Social entrepreneur: Works for social welfare (e.g., NGOs).

questions.question: Discuss the key functions and equality of successful women entrepreneurs.
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the key functions and qualities of successful women entrepreneurs. /
  • Key Functions:
  • • Planning: Setting business goals and strategies.
  • • Organizing: Arranging resources such as finance, manpower, and materials.
  • • Decision-making: Taking critical business decisions under uncertainty.
  • • Leadership: Managing and motivating employees effectively.
  • • Marketing and financial management: Ensuring profitability and sustainability.
  • Qualities of Successful Women Entrepreneurs:
  • • Self-confidence and determination
  • • Risk-taking ability
  • • Innovative thinking
  • • Strong communication skills
  • • Adaptability and resilience
  • • Time management and multitasking ability
  • Women entrepreneurs contribute significantly to economic development, employment
  • generation, and social empowerment.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the solution to the problems of women entrepreneurs.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the solutions to the problems of women entrepreneurs. /
  • • Financial support: Easy access to loans, subsidies, and microfinance schemes.
  • • Training and skill development: Entrepreneurship development programmes
  • (EDPs) and technical training.
  • • Government schemes: Special incentives and policies for women entrepreneurs.
  • • Market support: Assistance in marketing, branding, and export promotion.
  • • Networking opportunities: Formation of women entrepreneur associations and self-
  • help groups.
  • • Awareness and education: Promoting entrepreneurial mindset among women.
  • • Work-life balance support: Childcare facilities and flexible working conditions.
  • These measures help overcome barriers like lack of finance, social constraints, and limited
  • exposure.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the features of margin money scheme.
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the features of margin money scheme. /
  • Margin money scheme refers to financial assistance provided to entrepreneurs to meet a
  • portion of the project cost.
  • Key Features:
  • • Provides subsidy support to reduce the initial investment burden
  • • Helps entrepreneurs avail bank loans easily
  • • Applicable mainly to MSMEs and small-scale industries
  • • Margin money is linked to project cost and category of beneficiary
  • • Encourages self-employment and startup ventures
  • • Often non-refundable or treated as subsidy after certain conditions
  • • Promotes inclusive growth by supporting weaker sections
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: • Promotes inclusive growth by supporting weaker sections
